evidence.quote: (F) The proportion of TIL clones present in blood at different times.

clinical_significance.statement: TIL clones in blood doubled from 5% to 10.7% and were still detected at 8.9% two years after the protocol.

evidence.quote: Indeed, the cumulative frequency of TIL clones detected in blood doubled from 5% (PBMC-PRE) to 10.7% total frequency (PBMC-POST-3) (Figure 3F).

limitations: The mapping of P0, P1, P3, P4 to PBMC samples is inferred from the caption and text, not printed in the image.
